name: Circle 4H 10th Anniversary Omake Scenario
original_name: Circle 4H 10th Anniversary おまけシナリオ
source:
Scenario 1.
"Zenra Dream Park" a new amusement park is open in Japan. A popular theme park from France this is a 'Nude' theme park because in Germany and France where the park originated public nudity is more acceptable. [url=/c77339]Akari[/url] has gotten special pass tickets to attend the park for free for the student council as special status guests. The only requirement is that the girls attend the park naked. [url=/c16738]Shizuku[/url] can't pass up the opportunity to go to the amusement park for free so she meets Akari at 9am at the train station wearing nothing but a ribbon around her neck and they go to the theme park together. Rides! Attractions! Pictures with Dickey, the Dream Park mascot! Akari and Shizuku have fun together at the park while the guests get a chance to see such cute girls walking around naked.

Whle Akari is out buying them lunch Shizuku gets mistaken for one of the naked park staff and forced to walk around the park in the parade for all the guests to see.

Note, this scenario is unvoiced.

Scenario 2
Friends [url=/c16158]Aya[/url] [url=/c16737]Yuki[/url] and [url=/c16736]Momoe[/url] are on their way to school when a television crew ask them for an interview. They agree but the TV crew follows them while they do naked physical education, asks them questions, and films them while they exercise nude.

Note, this scenario is unvoiced.

Scenario 3
Super idol [url=/c16071]Saki Haruka[/url] takes part in a 100 km charity marathon. However unknown to Haruka this is all part of a 'Candid Camera' episode and her already sexy outfit is designed to dissolve with her sweat leaving Haruka to run the entire marathon naked.

Note, this is the only scenario which is voiced and only the character [url=/c16071]Saki Haruka[/url].

Scenario 4
Various heroines from 4H games meet each other at the park naked and discuss their lives and difficulties being naked in public together. Scenario includes [url=/c76901]Sana[/url], [url=/c76899]Arisu[/url] and [url=/c76902]Kanon[/url] from Zengaku! [url=/c16071]Saki Haruka[/url] and child actress [url=/c56685]Nanamiya Luna[/url], magical girls [url=/c85854]Touka[/url] and [url=/c85855]Kokoha[/url] and sisters [url=/c16155]Yuri[/url] and [url=/c16156]Shiori[/url].

Note, this scenario is unvoiced.
translation:
场景1。
日本新游乐园“Zenra Dream Park”开业。来自法国的一个受欢迎的主题公园，这是一个“裸体”主题公园，因为在公园起源的德国和法国，公共裸体更容易被接受。[url=/c77339]Akari[/url] 已获得学生会以特殊身份客人免费进入公园的特别通行证。唯一的要求是女孩们必须裸体进入公园。[url=/c16738]雫[/url]不能错过免费去游乐园的机会，所以早上9点她在火车站遇见了明里，脖子上只挂着一条丝带，他们一起去了主题公园。骑行！景点！与梦想公园吉祥物迪基合影！明里和雫在公园里一起玩耍，而客人们也有机会看到这些可爱的女孩裸体走来走去。

当明里出去给他们买午餐时，雫被误认为是一名裸体的公园工作人员，被迫在公园里走来走去，让所有客人都能看到。

请注意，此场景是无声的。

场景2朋友 [url=/c16158]Aya[/url] [url=/c16737]Yuki[/url] 和 [url=/c16736]Momoe[/url] 正在去学校的路上，电视台工作人员邀请他们接受采访。他们同意，但电视台工作人员在他们进行裸体体育训练时跟踪他们，问他们问题，并在他们裸体锻炼时拍摄他们。

请注意，此场景是无声的。

场景3超级偶像[url=/c16071]咲遥[/url]参加100公里慈善马拉松。然而遥并不知道，这都是“偷拍”剧集的一部分，她本已性感的服装被设计成会随着汗水而溶解，让遥在整个马拉松比赛中赤身裸体。

请注意，这是唯一有语音的场景，并且只有角色 [url=/c16071]Saki Haruka[/url]。

场景4
4H游戏中的各个女主角在公园里裸体见面，一起讨论她们在公共场合裸体的生活和困难。场景包括来自Zengaku的 [url=/c76901]Sana[/url]、[url=/c76899]Arisu[/url] 和 [url=/c76902]Kanon[/url]！[url=/c16071]Saki Haruka[/url] 和童星 [url=/c56685]Nanamiya Luna[/url]、魔法少女 [url=/c85854]Touka[/url] 和 [url=/c85855]Kokoha[/url] 和姐妹 [url=/c16155]Yuri[/url] 和[url=/c16156]诗织[/url]。

请注意，此场景是无声的。
